desc: US PeaceKeeper Shotgun Scabbard is heavily padded and framed for your shotguns protection. It offers tension and straps to hold shotgun in place during movement. A folded, buckled flap of 5" can be fully extended for additional length (from 29.5"to 34.5"). Detachable shoulder strap allows for sling or shoulder-carry. Scabbard fits Mossberg 590 Shockwave, Remington 870 TAC-14, pistol grip Airsoft Shotgun, and multiple other shotguns with pistol grip or overall length less than 34".
